note: The combat prototype contains useful deterministic combat logic but remains packaged under Assets/CombatPrototype and mixes simulation, orchestration, AI, presentation, direct mouse/UI input, demo content and world integration. Promote combat into production Game.Combat Api/Runtime boundaries and introduce Game.Input as a separate device-facing module that exposes device-neutral intent. Normal world/character/enemy objects remain authoritative participants; combat stays deterministic and independently testable.
